print("[cell] FF: dev scoring of final.py only when components_dev.npz is attached (19/11/2026)", flush=True)
# New cell (FourFusion reproduction repository, CHANGES.md). Experiment/CLEANCOMP-01/final.py, decoded from CODE_B64 by the setup cell,
# scores the four DEV lists with the new v11 head AFTER s007_xall.pt and v11_t3head.pt are saved (final.py lines 57-68). It reads
# components_dev.npz, a dev-list file of the e2e-dev bundle that no stage of this repository produces from raw data, and writes
# v11_head/t3_streams.npz, which no 13.54 stage reads (e50cc deletes and regenerates it). When no components_dev.npz is attached
# (mode (a) from raw data), the decoded final.py is edited on disk to skip that block; with the original inputs nothing changes.
# The path is built from two pieces because the runner rewrites the literal input path in stage code but not in decoded modules.
_KI = Path("/kag" + "gle/input")
_roots = [_KI] if _KI.exists() else [IN]                      # = final.py line 59: the literal path when it exists, else FLAG_IN
_dev = [p for r in _roots for p in r.rglob("components_dev.npz")]
FF_NO_DEV_SCORING = not _dev
if FF_NO_DEV_SCORING:
    _fp = LAB / "Experiment/CLEANCOMP-01/final.py"
    _src = _fp.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    _a_txt = '    cz = next(Path("' + str(_KI.as_posix()) + '").rglob("components_dev.npz")) if Path("' + str(_KI.as_posix()) + '").exists() else next(IN.rglob("components_dev.npz"))\n'
    _b_txt = "    H.score(hd, st, TAGS, wait_h=0.01)\n"
    assert _src.count(_a_txt) == 1 and _src.count(_b_txt) == 1, "final.py differs from the embedded original (lines 59 / 67)"
    _a, _b = _src.index(_a_txt), _src.index(_b_txt) + len(_b_txt)
    _src = _src[:_a] + ('    R.log("FF: components_dev.npz not attached: dev scoring of the new v11 head skipped '
                        '(v11_head/t3_streams.npz is read by no 13.54 stage)")\n') + _src[_b:]
    _fp.write_text(_src, encoding="utf-8")
    print("final.py: dev scoring block (lines 59-67) skipped in this run; s007_xall.pt and v11_t3head.pt are trained as before", flush=True)
else:
    print("components_dev.npz attached:", _dev[0], "-> final.py runs as originally", flush=True)
